title: DriveOddsBench: Are Driving Video World Models Aligned with Real-World Odds?
abstract: arXiv:2611.29275v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video world models predict how a scene will evolve, and their sampled futures are increasingly used in place of the real one, from planning to simulation. These uses assume that the samples are aligned with real-world odds, with each future appearing among them as often as it would follow the same history in reality, yet current evaluations only score how real each sample looks. Testing this assumption on real driving data is hard for three reasons. Each recorded history has only one real future, so the true probabilities are unknown. Physical quantities must be read from video, where reading errors can look like model errors. Finally, the many possible analyses invite selective reporting. We introduce DriveOddsBench, a pre-registered benchmark that addresses all three. translated_title: DriveOddsBench：驾驶视频世界模型是否与现实世界概率对齐？
translated_abstract: 视频世界模型预测场景将如何演变，其采样出的未来正被越来越多地用作真实未来的替代品，应用范围涵盖从规划到仿真。这些应用假设采样结果与现实世界的概率分布对齐，即每个未来在采样中出现的频率应与它在现实中跟随相同历史时出现的频率一致，然而目前的评估只对每个样本看起来有多真实进行打分。在真实驾驶数据上检验这一假设面临三个困难：每段记录的历史只有一个真实的未来，因此真实概率未知；物理量必须从视频中读取，读取误差可能被误认为模型误差；此外，多种可能的分析方式容易导致选择性报告。我们提出了DriveOddsBench，一个预先注册的基准，同时解决上述三个问题。首先，如果样本符合真实分布，那么真实结果在样本中的排名在每个历史下都应均匀分布，因此将排名汇总即可在无需概率标签的情况下检验模型（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了预先注册的基准DriveOddsBench，通过汇总真实结果在模型采样样本中的排名，检验驾驶视频世界模型采样分布是否与现实世界概率对齐。
en_tdlr: DriveOddsBench is a pre-registered benchmark that tests whether driving video world models' sampled futures are aligned with real-world odds by pooling the ranks of the real outcome among samples.
